newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African airline plagued by thieves.
newsitem.headline: S.African airline plagued by thieves.

text.p: Thieves plundered passengers flying South African Airways of possessions or luggage worth three million rand ($690,000) last year, a cabinet minister said on Tuesday.
Stella Sigcau, minister in charge of parastatals, said in reply to a question in parliament that passengers had reported 1,563 cases of theft of or from their luggage during 1996.

She said security had been stepped up, particularly at Johannesburg International Airport, but thefts continued because of the difficulty of monitoring baggage and "sophisticated methods used by thieves". Sigcau did not elaborate.

In the latest incident reported, an SAA cabin attendant was arrested by police last week following the theft of about 39,000 rand in cash from a sleeping passenger on board a flight from Zurich to Johannesburg. The money was returned to the traveller.
